source: ShadowBuyer fee taxonomy, compiled from card-network and processor statement conventions

interchange.label: Interchange
interchange.explain: Set by Visa/Mastercard/Discover/Amex, the same for every processor. Pass-through at cost on an honest statement.

assessment.label: Network assessments
assessment.explain: Card-brand dues and network fees. Pass-through at cost.

processor_markup.label: Processor markup
processor_markup.explain: Discount rates, tier surcharges and per-transaction fees above cost. This is where the processor makes money and where negotiation happens.

junk_fee.label: Junk fee
junk_fee.explain: Fixed monthly add-ons (statement, 'regulatory', insights, batch, PCI non-compliance) that cost the processor little or nothing to provide.

equipment_lease.label: Equipment lease
equipment_lease.explain: Terminal leases are usually separate, non-cancellable contracts that cost far more than buying the terminal.

rules.reason: Charged until you fill out a free 15-minute self-assessment questionnaire. Most processors will waive it once you do.

Fee to close out the day's sales. Usually waived on interchange-plus pricing.
Tiered pricing lets the processor decide which cards are 'non-qualified' and charge up to 1.65% extra on top of interchange.
Processor margin on top of interchange.
Per-transaction fee above the network cost. Fair benchmark is $0.05-$0.08.
